items.title: Ghadar di gunj
items.description: This is the cover of the book compiling Ghadarite poems published in 1913 and now in the possession of the Bancroft library,University of California, Berkeley. The work is known as 'Ghadar-di-Gunj' [alt. spelt 'Ghadar di Gunj', 'Ghadar' is alt. spelt as 'Ghadr/Gadar' whule 'Gunj' is alt. spelt as 'Goonj', sometimes the words are hyphenated and the Punjabic/Panjabic 'di/de' is Hindicized with 'ki/k
